summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz warned Iran and its proxies against carrying out attacks during the upcoming elections, stating Israel is prepared to thwart them and strike with full force. Concurrently, the US embassy ordered all staff and families to evacuate Saudi Arabia, and a drone strike targeted an IRGC missile launcher in Hormozgan Province, Iran.
key_points: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz warned Iran and its proxies against carrying out terror attacks aimed at influencing the upcoming elections, stating Israel is prepared to strike with full force. (Source: @manniefabian/59390)
The United States embassy in Saudi Arabia ordered all American personnel and their families to immediately evacuate the country. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8732)
A U.S. drone strike targeted an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps missile launcher in the Sirik mountains of Hormozgan Province, Iran, at 01:31 AM local time. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8737)
The U.S. Treasury Department imposed sanctions on five individuals, four companies, and nine vessels involved in Iran's shadow shipping network. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8724)
The IDF mistakenly struck a Lebanese army robotic vehicle and then a military transport in southern Lebanon, though no casualties or significant damage were reported. (Source: @yediotnews25/136605)

Heavy jet activity was observed over central Israel, while Iranian forces conducted flight operations over Tehran, West Azerbaijan, and Sardasht. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8735, @shin_persian/11382, @shin_persian/11368, @shin_persian/11372)
Syria's Homs oil refinery successfully returned Unit 10 to service, restoring an annual processing capacity of one million metric tons. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8726)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz warned Iran and its proxies against interfering in the upcoming elections, stating Israel is prepared to strike with full force if attacked. Concurrently, the US embassy ordered all staff and families to evacuate Saudi Arabia, and a drone strike targeted an IRGC missile launcher in Hormozgan Province, Iran.
iran: Netanyahu stated at an IDF graduation ceremony that Iran is actively trying to develop nuclear weapons and that toppling the regime is his official directive to the IDF, Mossad, and security agencies. (Source: @manniefabian/59390)
Defense Minister Katz warned that Iran is at its weakest point ever, which could lead to extreme measures, and vowed to strike with full force if Israel is attacked. (Source: @manniefabian/59390)
An IRGC missile launcher in the Sirik mountains of Hormozgan Province was targeted in a drone strike at 01:31 AM local time. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8737)
The US Treasury sanctioned 5 people, 4 companies, and 9 vessels linked to Iran’s shadow shipping network to disrupt illicit trade. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8724)
Jet activity was observed over Tehran, and at least 3 UAVs were spotted over West Azerbaijan with intense north-south activity. (Source: @shin_persian/11382, @shin_persian/11368)
Jet activity was heard clearly over Sardasht in West Azerbaijan, though no evacuation order was issued. (Source: @shin_persian/11372)

Iranian National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei stated that Trump left Iran's proposal to end the war unanswered, and warned that in a war, cables, data centers, and AI facilities could become targets. (Source: @N12chat/231207)

sections.threat_assessment: The regional threat level remains highly volatile as Israel prepares for national elections, with senior officials warning that Iran and its proxies may attempt disruptive attacks. The US evacuation of embassy staff from Saudi Arabia and the drone strike on IRGC assets in Hormozgan indicate escalating operational tensions. The mistaken IDF strike on Lebanese army assets highlights the risk of miscalculation along the northern border.
sections.regional_response: The United States has taken steps to secure its personnel in the Gulf by ordering an evacuation from Saudi Arabia while simultaneously targeting Iranian shadow shipping networks with sanctions. Israel is actively reinforcing its air defense and reconnaissance capabilities, as evidenced by heavy jet activity and electronic surveillance over Palestine. Regional actors like Lebanon are dealing with the spillover of mistaken IDF strikes on their military assets.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's National Security Council Secretary warned that critical infrastructure, including data centers and AI facilities, could be targeted in the event of a major conflict. Meanwhile, Israeli intelligence and security agencies are focused on safeguarding election integrity by removing foreign-influenced social media profiles. The discrepancy between Iran's diplomatic proposals and US responses suggests a breakdown in communication channels.
